content: Papuru Tsetsaxi hamatɨa kemɨtiutaxa
Hikɨ Petsitu nuaka hakewa mehɨritɨariekai, hairieka tukari 'aye'aku, Tsetsareya heyeyaka Kerutsaremetsie kaninuani.
Mawari wewiwamete tewa'aitɨwamete meta huriyutsixi wa'ukiyarima hɨxiena mekaniu'axɨani metehekɨatatɨ Papuru hepaɨtsita.
Mekanitawawirieni mɨpaɨ me'utiyuatɨ: «'Aixɨa petiuka'iyaritɨ Kerutsaremetsie Papuru kenanunɨ'a». Mɨkɨri yamepɨte'uxatakai huyeta kememɨte'imienikekai.
Petsitu mɨpaɨ katiniuta'ani: «Papuru Tsetsareya paitɨ kananutahɨiyaka, ne yareutewitɨ mana nepɨyemie.
Xetsata miemete memanuyetei nehamatɨa mekehekɨne, mɨkɨ yamekehetiyuani hepaɨtsitana, xɨkatsɨ kwinimieme 'axatiuyurieni».

Mɨixa pɨka'uyuri huriyutsixi watsata 'uyeikatɨ, 'atahaika tukari yatɨni tamamata tukari xeikɨa puyuri. Manaketa Tsetsareyatsie kaneyani. 'Uxa'arieka mɨrewa'aitatsie, Papuru mɨ'atɨarienikɨ katiniuta'aita.

Mana mɨkɨ nuaku 'auriena mekaniyukuxeɨrieni huriyutsixi, Kerutsaremetsie memakanexɨa, waɨkawa tɨrɨkawimekɨ 'axamekaniutiyuanekaitɨni memɨniukixienikɨ hepaɨtsitana. Mepɨyutatexi tixaɨ mepɨkate'ukaxei yuniukikɨ.
Papuru yuhetsie nuatɨ mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —'Atsinepɨkatiuyuri 'axati'anemekɨ huriyutsixi wa'inɨari niukiyari hepaɨtsita, watuki meta Tsetsaxi hepaɨtsita.
Petsitu wanaki'aritɨamɨtɨ huriyutsixi Papuru mɨpaɨ katiniuta'eiya: —¿Peti'awaɨriya Kerutsareme pemɨyemie mana pemɨta'iwawiyarienikɨ nehɨxie 'ikɨ xanetsika hepaɨtsita?

Papuru mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Ne Tsetsaxi 'uwenieya hɨxie nekaniuweni nemɨta'iwawiyarienikɨ. Mana xeikɨa temɨta'iwawiyarienikɨ xɨka 'axanetiuyurieni. 'Axanepɨkawaruyuri huriyutsixi, heitseriemekɨ 'ekɨ kepemɨtimate.

'Axa xɨka netiuyurienike, tixaɨ xɨka netiuyurienike kemɨreuyewetse nemɨmɨnikɨ, nepɨkaneku'imawa nemɨmɨnikɨ. Metsɨ xɨka katiyuritɨni 'ikɨ kememɨteniukixie nehepaɨtsita, xewitɨ pɨkayɨwe mɨkɨ wahetsɨa mɨnetsiyetuanikɨ wanaki'aritɨamɨtɨ. Tsetsaxi hɨxie nekanitaniumɨkɨ.
Hikɨ Petsitu 'imawamete wahamatɨa tiutaxataka meri mɨpaɨ katinita'eiya: —Tsetsaxi hetsɨa 'aku petimie. Hikɨ, Tsetsaxi hetsɨa pekaniyemieni.
Papuru 'Akɨripa meta Werenitse wahɨxie kemɨti'atɨarie
Hikɨ mɨixa tukari 'anukayaku, kwiepa ti'aitame 'Akɨripa mɨtitewa meta Werenitse hamatɨa Petsitu Tsetsareya paitɨ mekaneiku'iwata.
Yapaɨmexɨa tukari mana mepuyuri. Petsitu ti'aitame katinikuxaxatɨwakaitɨni Papuru hepaɨtsita, mɨpaɨ 'utaitɨ: —Xewitɨ tewi 'uwa puku'eiriwaxɨ Perixi menutahɨa.
Kerutsaremetsie neheta'aku, hepaɨtsitana mekateniutahekɨata mawari wewiwamete memɨhɨritɨarie, huriyutsixi wa'ukiyarima, menetsiwawirietɨ manutahɨiyanikɨ.

Netsɨ mɨpaɨ nekatiniwaruta'eiya, xumatari tayeiyari mɨpaɨ pɨka'ane, tewi tepɨka'iyetuani, hɨxiena meka'axɨawawekaku 'akuxi mɨkɨ hepaɨtsitana memɨniukixie, kayɨwekaku 'akuxi yuhetsiemieme mɨtaniuni waniukixiya hepaɨtsita.
'Uwa me'u'axɨaku, 'ayumieme 'anepɨkareuterixɨ. 'Uxa'arieka 'itsɨkame 'uwenieyatsie nemɨra'aitatsie ne'ayerɨka, nekatiniuta'aita mɨkɨ tewi mɨ'atɨarienikɨ.
Me'anuku'uka memɨtiniunikɨ, 'ixanetamete tixaɨtɨ 'axati'anekame mepɨkate'ukaxei hetsiena, ne kenemɨtita'ikwewakai.
Matsi xeikɨa niuki mekanixɨatɨakaitɨni tita memɨte'ayexeiya hepaɨtsita xeime Ketsutsi mɨmɨkikai hepaɨtsita, Papuru 'ayeniereme mɨxatakai, mɨkɨkɨ pɨta mekaniniukixiekaitɨni hepaɨtsitana.
Netsɨ 'atsinepɨkatimaikai 'ikɨ niuki hepaɨtsita. 'Ayumieme mɨpaɨ nekatinitahɨawe, ¿peti'awaɨriya Kerutsaremetsie pemɨyemie mana pemeta'iwawiyarienikɨ 'ikɨ hepaɨtsita?
Papuru kaneniutawawirieni nemi'ɨwiyanikɨ, ti'aitame 'Aukutsitu mi'enienike. 'Ayumieme nekatiniwaruta'aitɨani memi'ɨwiyanikɨ Tsetsaxi hetsɨa Xumatsie ne'enunɨ'ayuke.
'Akɨripa Petsitu mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: —Netatsiere mɨkɨ tewi nekani'eniemɨkɨ. Petsitu mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Karikɨ 'ekɨ 'uxa'a pekani'eniemɨkɨ.
Papuru yuhetsiemieme 'Akɨripa hɨxie kemɨtiutaniu

'Uxa'arieka 'Akɨripa Werenitse hamatɨa mekaniu'axɨani 'aixɨa mete'uyukemaritɨaka mariwemekɨ. Mana mɨrayutixexeɨritɨre mekaneutahaxɨani xeimiriyari kuyaxi tewa'aitɨwamete wahamatɨa, meta kiekatari memɨmatiwa wahamatɨa. Petsitu katiniuta'aita Papuru mawitɨkienikɨ.

Hikɨ Petsitu mɨpaɨ kaniutayɨni: —Ti'aitame 'Akɨripa, meta xeme yunaitɨ tahamatɨa xemuyuxeɨrie, manari 'ikɨ tewi xekanixeiyani kemɨ'ane hepaɨtsita waɨriyarika xemɨnetsi'upitɨa yunaitɨ teɨteri huriyutsixi Kerutsaremetsie, mɨpaɨ mete'uhiwatɨ kename 'aixɨa ka'ane mayeniereni.
Ne tixaɨtɨ nepɨkatiukaxei kemɨtiuyuri kemɨreuyewetse mɨmierienikɨ. Mɨkɨtsɨ 'Aukutsitu yamɨtiutahɨawixɨkɨ, ne yanepɨtimaikai Xuma nemenunɨ'anikɨ.
Niuki mɨheitserie nepɨkahexeiya ti'aitame nemititi'utɨirienikɨ. 'Ayumieme nekani'atɨani xehetsɨa, meta 'ahetsɨa ti'aitame 'Akɨripa, pe'ita'iwawiyame tixaɨtɨ nemɨrexeiyanikɨ nemɨtiti'utɨanikɨ.
Timaiweme hepaɨ nepɨkayɨnikeyu xɨka xeime nehenɨ'anike hɨakame, nekatihekɨatatɨ ketitakɨ mɨtiniukimarie.
